description.value:
You sheathe one hand in a thin, edged chakra blade. For the next minute (or until you cast another jutsu of rank 2 or higher), your unarmed Strike with that hand deals 1d6 slashing damage with the agile and finesse traits, and your Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage from severed chakra threads.

If you make a Strike against a target you are also Treating (with the Medicine skill), you can swap the precision damage for healing — restore 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier HP to the target instead (this is the surgical use of the technique).

Heightened (4th) Precision damage / healing increases to 2d4 / 2d6.
